title: Airchelon research source file
description: Output contract for the research agent. Prose is not a valid output. Every factual claim that reaches a draft must correspond to a record here.

piece_id.description: Matches the piece ID in the review tool

brief.description: The commissioning brief this research was run against

model_id.description: Pinned model ID, never a floating alias

prompt_commit.description: Git commit hash of prompts/research-agent.md at run time

claim.description: A single factual assertion, one sentence. Not a summary.

quote_or_locator.description: Short excerpt or section reference. Keep excerpts minimal.

confidence.description: direct = the source states this plainly. inferred = the source supports it but does not state it. contested = sources disagree; requires a paired record taking the other position. unsourced = no source found; the gap is recorded rather than filled.

contested_pair.description: ID of the opposing record. Required when confidence is 'contested'.
